about: Brodie's telling of the story so far (src/film.js). Changing a line here and pushing has the workflow (.github/workflows/narration.yml) ask the sphere Worker to speak it in Brodie's ElevenLabs voice, once, and keep the clip in assets/film/vo/. Lines that haven't changed are not spoken again.

lines.say: A fleet of probes went out, each one looking for a place where life could carry on.
Our land carries Earth's blueprint, and a snapshot of everyone alive in twenty twenty-seven.
A few centuries out, our ship lost its navigation.
The wormhole links the ships of the fleet. Things come through it.
One ship carries the Shred Hole: a fabricator that lost its Earth blueprint in an accident.
Before it went dark, another ship found something. It called it World Builder.
So it's up to us to find our way again.
Until then, we garden. We build the wall. And whatever else suits our fancy, brody.
